alt_texts: Asian weaver ants swarming over a nest of green leaves joined with silk, headline 'These ants sew with their own babies'
Weaver ants clinging to each other in a chain hanging from a railing, with text about pulling leaves and forming bridges

Dozens of weaver ants working on leaves at a nest edge, with text explaining only larvae can produce silk
Weaver ants carrying a dead gecko across a wooden beam, with the statistic 500,000 workers in a colony
Close view of a silk-bound weaver ant nest, with text on 1,700 years of use as pest control in China
Closing slide listing sources and photo credits over weaver ants on leaves
